description: This file defines the 'types' package for CEL (Common Expression Language), including type representations, conversions between native and protobuf types, and type traits and utilities.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a CEL runtime type with associated traits, parameters, and type name.

methods.name: ConvertToNative
methods.description: Converts the Type to a native Go type; not supported for 'type'.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts the Type to another ref.Val type, such as string.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two types have the same runtime type name.

methods.name: HasTrait
methods.description: Checks if the type has a specific trait.

methods.name: IsExactType
methods.description: Checks if two types are exactly the same, including type parameters.

methods.name: IsEquivalentType
methods.description: Checks if two types are equivalent, ignoring type parameter names.

methods.name: Kind
methods.description: Returns the general category of the type.

methods.name: isTypeInternal
methods.description: Internal method to check type equivalence or exact match based on a flag.

methods.name: IsAssignableType
methods.description: Determines if the current type can be assigned from another type.

methods.name: IsAssignableRuntimeType
methods.description: Checks if a runtime value is assignable to this type.

methods.name: Parameters
methods.description: Returns the list of type parameters.

methods.name: DeclaredTypeName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified, parameterized type name.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the ref.Type interface implementation.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the type name as the value.

methods.name: TypeName
methods.description: Returns the runtime type name.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the type as a string.

methods.name: WithTraits
methods.description: Creates a copy of the type with specified traits.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the type.

methods.name: isDyn
methods.description: Checks if the type is dynamic, any, or a type parameter.

methods.name: defaultIsAssignableType
methods.description: Default logic for type assignability.

methods.name: defaultIsAssignableRuntimeType
methods.description: Default logic for runtime value assignability.

methods.name: NewListType
methods.description: Creates a list type with specified element type.

methods.name: NewMapType
methods.description: Creates a map type with specified key and value types.

methods.name: NewNullableType
methods.description: Creates a nullable version of a primitive type.

methods.name: NewOptionalType
methods.description: Creates an optional type.

methods.name: NewOpaqueType
methods.description: Creates an opaque, abstract type.

methods.name: NewObjectType
methods.description: Creates a type reference to an external object type.

methods.name: NewObjectTypeValue
methods.description: Deprecated: creates a type reference to an external object type.

methods.name: NewTypeValue
methods.description: Deprecated: creates a type with traits.

methods.name: NewTypeParamType
methods.description: Creates a parameterized type.

methods.name: NewTypeTypeWithParam
methods.description: Creates a type with a type parameter.

methods.name: TypeToExprType
methods.description: Converts a native Type to protobuf expression type.

methods.name: ExprTypeToType
methods.description: Converts protobuf expression type to native Type.

methods.name: AlphaProtoAsType
methods.description: Converts protobuf CEL v1alpha1.Type to native Type.

methods.name: ProtoAsType
methods.description: Converts canonical protobuf CEL type to native Type.

methods.name: TypeToProto
methods.description: Converts native Type to protobuf CEL type.

methods.name: maybeWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a type in a protobuf wrapper if it is assignable from null.

methods.name: maybeForeignType
methods.description: Converts a foreign type to a CEL type, treating it as struct if traits indicate.

methods.name: convertProto
methods.description: Serializes and deserializes protobuf messages.

methods.name: primitiveType
methods.description: Creates a primitive protobuf type.
